04 / Challenge

Frame the decision

Hypotheses to validate

How might we help users confidently apply AI-generated fixes?

  1. 01

    What changed?

    Seeing the difference may make a fix easier to evaluate.

  2. 02

    Why is it better?

    A clear rationale may help users judge the recommendation.

  3. 03

    Am I in control?

    Editing and recovery may make applying a fix feel safer.

Working hypotheses · To validate through research and testing

05 / Solution

Make review actionable

Three design principles

Design the decision, step by step.

01

Make changes visible.

Put the original and proposed content side by side so users can inspect the change before applying it.

  • 01Compare the same field
  • 02Highlight the exact edits
02

Explain the recommendation.

Keep the rationale beside the suggestion and connect it to the SEO issue being addressed.

  • 01Link rationale to the issue
  • 02Keep the explanation in context
03

Keep users in control.

Let users review and edit the suggestion, confirm when to apply it, and recover through a clear revert path.

  • 01Review and edit before applying
  • 02Make the applied state and revert path clear

Three principles guide the proposed review experience.
